title: Summer in Spain
instructions: Ben ailesiyle İspanya'daki yaz tatilini anlatıyor. Kalış süresine ve yaptıklarına dikkat et.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: Every summer, my family goes to Spain.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: We stay in a small hotel near the sea for ten days.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: The weather is always hot and sunny.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: In the morning, we go to the beach. In the afternoon, we sleep because it is too hot.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: In the evening, we eat in a restaurant and walk by the sea.
